operational_issues.title: booking-task-callback-test returns HTTP 200 with empty body for Telegram UX callbacks
operational_issues.root_cause: Respond to Webhook gated on $json.simulated===true but several code paths omit simulated field; false IF branch has no response
operational_issues.impact: Automated UAT cannot verify these steps; staff Telegram UX may still fire but webhook callers get no structured feedback
operational_issues.recommended_fix: Add simulated:true to all test-webhook return paths OR remove IF gate and always respond on test webhook path

operational_issues.title: Duplicate supplier confirmation with new idempotency_key overwrites confirmation_ref
operational_issues.evidence: Two booking_supplier_responses rows; task.confirmation_ref=UAT-KZ-HTL-DUP after second confirmed callback
operational_issues.impact: Staff can accidentally overwrite a valid supplier reference
operational_issues.recommended_fix: Block confirmed response when task.status=confirmed unless explicit override; or require same confirmation_ref

operational_issues.title: Laila Phase1 scenario harness not deployed
